{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cloud Paradise''' was a tall residential building constructed from black [[Granite/Legends|granite]] which was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran|Face Loran]] visited [[Zehrinne Thaal]] in her [[Zehrinne Thaal's apartment|apartment]] on the building to discuss her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK" />
